name: FLUSH REWRITE RULES - temporal
desc: Flushes rewrite rules so CPT URLs work. Desactivar despues de ejecutar.
code:
<?php
add_action('init', function() {
    if (!get_option('ficha_motel_rules_flushed')) {
        flush_rewrite_rules(false);
        update_option('ficha_motel_rules_flushed', true, false);
    }
}, 99);
